decisions_to_review: SUPERSEDED by the lead ruling 2026-11-08 (resource-less admission not accepted): the job's resource is the open package's document id (bound to its head, as as_export_job), else an SDOC id in the UUIDv7 shape from the SHA-256 of the site's folder (local_root, else the open document's folder, canonical when it resolves), bound to the web source revision; the port is always asked. A real host's Job Runtime may not know that derived id (NOT_INSPECTED: kernel-bindings BridgeJobs forwards it; a host refusal arrives as overloaded with its hint).

Style sheets (.css) are scanned through the engine by wrapping them as a style body (no second scanner), so an image used only from a style sheet is not an orphan, a site export copies it, and a move rewrites and re-bases url() in .css files; beyond the brief's every .html/.htm.
A case-only mismatch (Thanks.html vs thanks.html) is a broken link (case_mismatch) and, for a non-page reference in the site export, asset_missing: deterministic across file systems.
Open export: a navigation link naming an existing folder without a trailing slash is now listed in links (was asset_missing).
Site export refuses an output inside the site (output_inside_site); the entry recipe.file must be a document of the set (entry_document_missing).

web.move_file refuses a document with a site record beside it (move_site_record), a kind change (move_kind_changes) and a case-only rename (move_case_only) instead of moving the record or renaming in two steps.
Recipe gains documents (open|site) in state_json and the sidecar (additive key).
Q3 widens recipe.file to a root-relative path of portable segments (web.export_recipe and the sidecar accept pages/x.html); the open export refuses such a file document_outside_site_root.
web.site_report admits as Action::Export, not Read (no Read in the session Action enum).
